hero.subtitle: Bridging clinical medicine and machine intelligence to build healthcare AI systems that clinicians can trust.

educationLines: B.S. Data Science, Minor in Business
paragraphs: I am a senior at the University of Michigan, pursuing a major in Data Science with a minor in Business, on a premedical track. My work sits at the intersection of clinical medicine and machine intelligence - I believe the most meaningful advances in healthcare will come from people who understand both the data and the patient.

My research centers on large language models for clinical applications, computer-aided detection in medical imaging, and the design of AI systems that clinicians can actually trust. I have contributed to publications in JAMA and the Journal of Bone and Joint Surgery.

This summer, I am a Software Development Engineer Intern at Amazon in the Alexa AI organization, building data pipelines that measure the impact of model changes and LLM agents that automate metric onboarding.

Outside of research, I serve as President of the Michigan Data Science Team and direct technology strategy at Blueprints for Pangaea. When I am away from my laptop, you will find me perfecting my ramen broth, engineering smashburgers, or reverse-searing a steak.

experience.description: Building data pipelines to deploy and measure the impact of model changes in Alexa AI, and developing LLM agents that automate new-metric onboarding - cutting turnaround from roughly a month to a day.
Fine-tuning clinical LLMs and integrating multimodal data for bladder-cancer extraction and five-year survival modeling research.
Contributed to peer-reviewed diversity research and LLM-assisted systematic review workflows in clinical research settings.
Built ML and generative AI workflows for billing compliance and coding-risk analysis at scale across large primary-care revenue streams.
Conducted wet-lab and analysis work on sleep and memory consolidation models, including data collection and experimental support.
Built Python-based GenAI automation and ETL workflows for high-precision data collection and lead intelligence pipelines.
Managed media/data operations and VBA-supported processing workflows for health content and platform datasets.

leadership.description: Lead one of the largest student data science organizations in the country, overseeing projects, education, and partnerships.
Directed data strategy and technology initiatives for a nonprofit focused on medical device redistribution.
